notes: Bendall notes that the last two leaves containing the date are a late palm-leaf supply (the rest being 12th-13th century). The remaining text of the colophon after the date is in vernacular (Newari) and omitted by Bendall ('etc. (the rest is in a vernacular)'), hence no persons could be extracted. The month 'āvananaṣṭa' probably represents Śrāvaṇa (naṣṭa- / adhika-māsa).
